handback.t:
I catalogued `C:/Users/mariu/neural-mesh` without changing anything. `src/bin/` has 146 `.rs` binaries plus 42 `*_common/` helper directories (they hold each lab's world and policy code, e.g. `g21_common/{extract,indep,nlgen,pipe}.rs`). `Cargo.toml` has no `[[bin]]` entries, so every file is an auto-discovered binary.

**Where the round labels come from:**
- `RD-LOG.md` (Team A, R0–R116, final round R116, HEAD `ec54d6a`) covers the n* benches, `m1_persist`, `meshstore` and `b1_exec`.
- `RD-LOG-B.md` (Team B, B1–B50) covers `b14_statemerge`, `meshstore`'s sync work and `tests/b11`.

### py/ (`C:/Users/mariu/neural-mesh/py/`)
- **`b1/`** (114 files) is the battery, the verify-before-keep harness:
  - `gen.py`: generates 25 sub-skill proxies × worlds A/B × seeds 1–90, plus knowledge stores → `b1_items/texts/emb`.
  - `embed.py`: local MiniLM via onnxruntime from `~/.ruvector`.
  - `lib.py`: axes, splits (TUNE 1–30 / HELD 31–60 / CONF 61–90), worlds, kNN router, real world R.
  - `battery.py`: `run_battery(...)` → table[(world, seed)] → {axis: value}. Its `__main__` writes `b1_baseline.json`.
  - `gate.py`, `compare(base, cand, target)`: paired per-seed differences for every axis × world (A, B, R) × split (HELD, CONF), Holm over the whole family, TOST ±0.01 for non-target axes.
    - "Improves" means a target axis has a Holm-significant gain in the same world in both HELD and CONF.
    - "Regresses" means any axis has a Holm-significant loss beyond `tol`.
    - `tok_*` cost axes have their sign flipped and need a change of more than 0.5 token.
    - Verdict is KEEP, REJECT-regress or REJECT-nogain.
  - `rounds.py` and `lab.py` (runs a candidate and logs to jsonl); `eff.py` (vector-compression rounds); `v2.py` (verbal battery V2); `recipes.py` (kept scoring recipes); `sem.py`, `lex.py`.
  - Data: `data_domain.py`, `data_verbal{,2,3}.py`, `data_route{2,3,4}.py`.
  - Generators: `identity_gen.py`, `identity_truth.py`, `rounding_gen.py`, `lookup_gen.py`; parity fixtures `mk_parity{,2,3}.py`.
  - Per-round scripts `r01.py`…`r115.py` and `b3.py`…`b49.py`; tool folders `r85_tools/` (encoder variants) and `r101_tools/export_weights.py`.
- **`registry/`**: capability registry. `scan.py`
